unitTitle: B2 · Capstone: transfer across four skills and all TCF tasks
title: Listening practice
subtitle: B2 · Unit 14: B2 · Capstone: transfer across four skills and all TCF tasks

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Votre réponse compare les deux sources, mais la deuxième idée est attribuée au mauvais auteur. Corrigez l'attribution avant de modifier la conclusion.
steps.question: What should the learner correct first?
options: Which author made the second point
steps.explain: The feedback says the second idea is attributed to the wrong author.

steps.fr: Le candidat a bien compris l'enregistrement, mais il n'a pas répondu à la question sur la conséquence. Il doit revenir à la consigne et vérifier chaque partie.
steps.question: What is the main issue?
options: One requested part was not answered
steps.explain: The candidate missed the part asking about a consequence.

steps.fr: Cette estimation pourrait être utile, à condition que l'échantillon soit représentatif. Le rapport ne donne pas cette information.
steps.question: What remains unknown?
options: Whether the result is useful in theory
Whether the report contains an estimate
steps.explain: The report does not say whether the sample is representative.
